topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
response: On-board storage constraints limit data packet size for time-tagged services, influencing payload power allocation. Prioritization between immediate and time-tagged services depends on buffer size (bs) and data packet size (lj).
reference_context: Satellite on-board memory buffers have limited size, affecting time-tagged service data storage and operation scheduling.
